facts.business: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of pharmaceutical formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients across chronic and acute therapies in India and international markets.

auditor.name: M/s. M. C. Gupta & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: There were no qualification / observations in the report.

key_risks: Strategic risk due to delays in product development and launch, regulatory landscape, capital investments on new projects and inorganic growth opportunities
Product Quality and Regulatory Risk including product efficacy, adverse drug reactions, unexpected side effects, drug interactions, medication errors

Regulatory compliance risk including failure to comply with cGMP requirements resulting in regulatory warnings, failure/delay to secure approvals, withdrawal of certification, product recalls, product liability claims
Patent litigation risk for generic product launches
Capital project risk including delay in implementation, cost overrun, demand slump, underutilization of capacities
facts.related_party_note: Total purchases includes raw material, packing material, trading goods, stores, laboratory chemicals and capital expenditure for tangible assets. There are no purchases from related party of raw material, packing material and stock-in-trade. Loans & advances given to related parties / Total loans & advances: 0%. Investments in related parties / Total Investments made: 88% (FY 2025-26), 89% (FY 2024-25).
